label: Localizing evaluation failures and the verbatim error catalog for nix-diagnose, keyed by input shape and version
brief:
Decide how an agent localizes an evaluation failure, and assemble the verbatim error catalog the nix-diagnose skill reads.
Rows: M-C-08, M-C-09, M-C-12, M-K-03 and new M-C-16 (nix eval --json over an attrset with outPath prints only that string) (nix-topic-map.md, section Wave 3 landed).
Seed first, plant second. Harvest every verbatim error string already on disk before planting anything: nix-flakes.md (battery logs, FLK-19 Lix table); nix-gates.md V1-V22; nix-generated-flakes.md (401, 404, builder exit 6, hash mismatch, abort-on-warn license error, auto-patchelf could not satisfy dependency, unsupported ocx token); nix-inputs.md (follow cycle detected vs Lix stack overflow, access to absolute path forbidden vs the 2.20.6 points-outside text, --update-input on Lix, unable to download); nix-packaging.md P1-P14; nix-release.md C1-C9. Re-run a harvested row on its recorded fixture only where it lacks an exit code, a version or an implementation.
Fetch: NixOS/nixpkgs PR 370967 and issue 550879; lix.systems/blog/2026-03-25-lix-2.95-release; NixOS/nix issues 3872 and 8013; nix-community/nixd libnixf/src/Basic/diagnostic.py.
Plant in fixtures/evaluation-failures/ only what is missing: an overlay reading final where prev is required; imports computed from config; a per-system helper that recurses (helix-editor/helix@079a789e8cb0 pkgsFor on x86_64-freebsd); an undefined variable reached only when forced; a stale eval-cache error after the fix (#3872); an unfree refusal; a platform-unavailable dependency; a flake reached through a symlink (#8013); the nix eval --json outPath collapse; NIX-FLK-03's apps and templates errors on CppNix 2.31.5 and Lix 2.95.2, which were never run there.
Every catalog row gives the verbatim string, implementation and version, cause, first command, fix and rule ID. Key rows by input shape, never by string alone, because the same fault changes text across versions and implementations (class C20). Add a misattributed-diagnostics section (class C7): the self.packages alias blamed for NIX-FLK-07's read, helix's cost blamed on inputs, pkgs.system blamed on the import spelling, and a bad digest giving 404, not hash mismatch.
Decide: the localization procedure (--show-trace, --no-eval-cache, nix repl, the NIX-FLK-19 implementation check; nixf-diagnose stays editor-only per NIX-GATE-07); the catalog, at least 40 rows, each reproduced; which rows become NIX-LANG rules and which stay skill-only.
Env: Nix only via /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/nix-tools/run.sh (CppNix 2.35.2, nixpkgs 26.11pre 8d5d2709; CppNix 2.31.5 via nix shell nixpkgs#nixVersions.nix_2_31; Lix 2.95.2 via nix shell nixpkgs#lix; nixfmt 1.5.0, nixfmt-tree, deadnix 1.3.2, statix, nixf-diagnose, flake-checker 0.2.15, nix-update, nurl, jq). Wrap each call in timeout 300. run.sh enters the store through bwrap with SQLite WAL on, so parallel dives are fine. If timeout 60 run.sh nix --version fails, write ENVIRONMENT FAULT as the artifact's first line and stop all Nix work; never park a verification as blocked by contention. Fixtures go under /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/nix-tools/fixtures/ (never /tmp); git init -q and git add -A before any eval. Exemplars are read-only under ~/.cache/research-lang/exemplars/nix/ (SHAs in nix-fetch.log). Pipe grep and find through rtk proxy. Run every check verbatim: a directory operand, one -e per alternative, quoted --include globs, xargs -r, no placeholders. Each check goes red on the violation and green on the twin, and its write-up states what empty output means, the versions, and whether the store was cold or warm.

label: Residual language idioms generated Nix gets wrong: plain rec, with, //, paths and string context, impure builtins, URL literals
brief:
Decide which Nix language idioms generated code still gets wrong once the wave-2/3 rules apply, with a rule and a check for each.
Already settled, so cite and do not re-derive: lint severities (NIX-GATE-05 deadnix MUST with --no-lambda-pattern-names; NIX-GATE-06 statix advisory, acting only on W12 and W17; NIX-GATE-07 nixf-diagnose editor-only; on Nix 2.35+, --option lint-url-literals fatal is the native W12, V11b); mkDerivation rec vs finalAttrs (NIX-PKG-14: finalAttrs only for self-reference); abort-on-warn only on named current attributes (NIX-REL-11, which replaces the wave-2 amendment calling it the general consumer-noise check); pkgs.system (NIX-FLK-12); builtin fetchers (NIX-INP-10).
Rows: M-C-01 (plain rec only), M-C-02, M-C-04..07, M-C-10, M-C-13, M-C-14 (nix-topic-map.md). Map conflict 20 is the direction to confirm or overturn, for with and plain rec only.
Fetch: nix.dev/guides/best-practices; nix.dev/manual/nix/2.35/language/ (string context, paths, lookup paths, builtins); nix-community/nixd libnixf/src/Basic/diagnostic.py (sema-extra-with, sema-extra-rec, merge-diff-rec); Nix release notes rl-2.23 (builtins.warn) and rl-2.34 (lint-url-literals); nixpkgs lib/attrsets.nix recursiveUpdate in the exemplar clone.
Measure per 1,000 lines over the exemplars, excluding test_data, tests/fixtures and vendor (NIX-GATE-04): with at file or module scope vs list scope; a // whose right side sets a nested path the left side also sets; path interpolation into strings; <nixpkgs>, currentSystem and getEnv outside default.nix and shell.nix compat shims.
Plant bad and good twins in fixtures/idioms-and-scope/:
- fixtures/nix-gates/format-and-lint/lint-cases/rec-merge.nix against a twin, on CppNix 2.35.2, 2.31.5 and Lix 2.95.2 (V19 found that Lix rejects the rec/non-rec merge);
- a path interpolated into a string: is a store path shown, is the directory copied, and how large is it;
- string context dropped with unsafeDiscardStringContext and then used as a dependency;
- builtins.warn and lib.warn under abort-on-warn, scoped per NIX-REL-11;
- a self-shadowing plain rec.
Drop any candidate an agent already gets right or a gate lint already denies; in that case state the lint config instead (rule-distillation, Selection).
Decide: the NIX-LANG ruleset (MUST/SHOULD/CONSIDER), each rule with a check, its measured frequency, and its floor and implementation.

label: nixConfig, accept-flake-config, tokens, secrets in the store, daemon floors, and evaluating untrusted flakes
The smallest module-evaluating check, module authoring rules, and whether modules.md ships or folds into NIX-FLK
brief:
Decide how a flake that exports NixOS, home-manager, nix-darwin or flake-parts modules writes and checks them, and whether modules.md ships at all. Owner Q7's default is that no fleet flake exports a module, so keep the effort proportional; this dive is the first to drop if the budget binds.
Rows: M-I-01..06, M-I-08 (nix-topic-map.md).
Already settled, so cite: nix flake check only forces nixosModules (NIX-FLK-06: nixosModules.default = 42 passes on CppNix 2.35.2, 2.31.5 and Lix); mkRenamedOptionModule forwards an option and a lib.warn wrapper does not (NIX-REL-10(e), fixtures/nix-release/module-rename/); read pkgs.stdenv.hostPlatform.system, never pkgs.system (NIX-FLK-12); a C flake's modules use the consumer's pkgs (NIX-INP-02).
Fetch: nixos.org/manual/nixos/unstable (Writing NixOS Modules, Option Types); nix.dev/tutorials/module-system/deep-dive; RFC 42 (rfcs/0042-config-option.md); nixpkgs lib/modules.nix and lib/options.nix (mkPackageOption); flake.parts module-authoring docs.
Test against: Mic92/sops-nix@2bd00bd9bb35, nix-community/disko@725ea35e410a and nix-community/home-manager@7b4c5ec4beda. Record how each module takes pkgs, whether any reads the flake's own nixpkgs, and whether any indexes self.packages by pkgs.system.
Plant in fixtures/module-authoring/:
- the smallest checks entry that evaluates nixosModules.default (lib.evalModules, or lib.nixosSystem with a minimal config); it must go red on the 42 twin and on a module with an option-type error, go green on a correct module, and have its eval cost recorded;
- a module using mkOption, mkEnableOption, mkPackageOption and a settings option via pkgs.formats.json;
- a module that indexes self.packages by pkgs.system (count the rename warnings);
- a secret path option typed types.pathWith { inStore = false; }.
Decide: which module rows pass the four selection tests of rule-distillation (at most a handful); whether modules.md ships as NIX-MOD, or its rows fold into NIX-FLK (FLK-06's check) and NIX-REL (REL-10(e)) with the NIX-MOD prefix never used.
